## Use When

Use when composing v2 feedback and forms.

## Do

- Keep Banner title descriptive.
- Link ErrorSummary items to controls.
- Use Button for actions and links for navigation.

## Do Not

- Rely on tone color alone.
- Use placeholder text as the only label.

## Example

Critical banners should be reserved for blocking operational issues.
